accent-prime.$description: Accent-prime: Atlantic-pigment editorial red (amendment 2026-05-10). Replaces #c8392b (alarm vermilion). Cosmology framing preserved: Inferno-infra surfacing at the masthead.

concept-citation.universal-concept: Inferno-infra surfacing through Purgatorio-terraces — Prime's heartbeat visible at brand-bearing surfaces (CD2 §4.2 Decision 5)

accent-prime-active.$description: Accent-prime-active: wine intermediate for nav active state. Sits chromatically BETWEEN copper and wordmark-red per illuminated-manuscript graduated-pigment discipline (Decision 8).

concept-citation.universal-concept: Graduated-pigment engagement arc (illuminated-manuscript discipline, CD2 amendment Decision 8)

copper.$description: Copper: Prime-wide gilded identity. Default nav link color at display registers. Decision 8 redistributes copper-as-institution from wordmark to nav. Size-scoped per F5 (register §10, ADR-0003): display-size copper stays canon (WCAG large-text 3:1); label/body-size copper text uses copper-label.

concept-citation.universal-concept: Gilded institutional identity redistributed to wayfinding (CD2 amendment Decision 8)

copper-deep.$description: Copper-deep: nav hover state. Engagement deepening within copper register.

concept-citation.universal-concept: Engagement deepening within the gilded register (CD2 amendment Decision 8)

copper-label.$description: Copper-label: the F5 size-scoped AA variant of copper for label/body-size text (<18pt regular / <14pt bold) and for fills that carry light label text. Darkened within the canon copper hue family (C/H held from #b87333) to the lightest value clearing WCAG 1.4.3 AA with margin: 4.66:1 on sky-low (#f6f1e7), 5.11:1 on sky-high, 4.94:1 under vellum-25 text as a fill, 4.66:1 under sky-low text. Sits between copper (L 0.60) and copper-deep (L 0.48) so the hover-deepening arc survives. Display-size copper stays canon per register §10.

concept-citation.universal-concept: Size-scoped split of the gilded register — WCAG 2.2 AA at label sizes without surrendering display copper (ADR-0003 register §10, F5)

prime.ratified-at: ADR-0003 register §10 (AK, 2026-08-18) — executed S2; per-node math in __tests__/contrast.test.mjs

on-copper.$description: Text role for copper-label-filled surfaces (filter pill, CTA hover fills). Resolves to vellum-25: 4.94:1 on copper-label. Added at F5 execution so no component hardcodes its own on-fill literal.

concept-citation.universal-concept: Single on-fill text role over the gilded register (ADR-0003 register §10, F5)

text-body-strong.$description: Text-body-strong: primary text token. Warm-bias near-black paired with the Vellum scale's warm-yellow hue family (~88°). Never pure black.

concept-citation.universal-concept: Reading-substrate strongest text intensity (CD2 §3.3 β principal-grade body)

wordmark.$description: Wordmark composition (color.md §5.2 Option C split-color cosmology-encoded): DIS portion = accent-prime (Inferno-surfacing red); patch portion = text-body-strong (institutional weight).

dis.$description: Wordmark `DIS` portion — inherits accent-prime via DTCG aliasing. City of Dis from Inferno at masthead scale.

concept-citation.universal-concept: City of Dis from Inferno (CD1 thesis §4.2)

patch.$description: Wordmark `patch` portion — institutional-publication weight in dark serif.

platform.$description: Platform tier — Prime-platform-wide tokens (cross-Building DNA). DTCG 2025.10. Values are the amendment-locked truth (authority chain: color.md CD2 v1 → cd2-color-amendment-proposal 2026-05-10 Mayor-locked → tokens.css); $extensions.prime.css carries the exact emission string, validated for equivalence against $value by validate-dtcg.mjs.
